command:
set -Eeuo pipefail; test "$(hostname)" = 'ai-core-node-projekt-frankenstein' || exit 77; W=/home/ai-core-node/frankenstein-avatar-go/c0dd67ea; C=$W/candidate; LIVE=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual; T=$W/testroot-v2; rm -rf "$T"; mkdir -p "$T"; for p in "$LIVE"/*; do n=$(basename "$p"); case "$n" in buehne.html|buehne_daemon.py|filmlook.js|zustand.json) ;; *) ln -s "$p" "$T/$n";; esac; done; cp "$C/buehne.html" "$C/filmlook.js" "$C/zustand.json" "$T/"; python3 -m http.server 8799 --directory "$T" >"$W/evidence/http8799-v2.log" 2>&1 & SPID=$!; trap 'kill $SPID 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT; sleep 1; curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8799/buehne.html -o "$W/evidence/candidate_root-v2.html"; echo '=== HTTP ==='; sha256sum "$W/evidence/candidate_root-v2.html" "$C/buehne.html"; test "$(sha256sum "$W/evidence/candidate_root-v2.html"|cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$(sha256sum "$C/buehne.html"|cut -d' ' -f1)"; CH=/opt/google/chrome/chrome; U=/tmp/frank-g1-probe-$$; V=/tmp/frank-g1-normal-$$; "$CH" --headless=new --no-sandbox --disable-dev-shm-usage --disable-gpu --user-data-dir="$U" --virtual-time-budget=14000 --dump-dom 'http://127.0.0.1:8799/buehne.html?probe=1' > "$W/evidence/probe_dom-v2.html" 2>"$W/evidence/probe_chrome-v2.err"; "$CH" --headless=new --no-sandbox --disable-dev-shm-usage --disable-gpu --user-data-dir="$V" --virtual-time-budget=1500 --dump-dom 'http://127.0.0.1:8799/buehne.html' > "$W/evidence/normal_dom-v2.html" 2>"$W/evidence/normal_chrome-v2.err"; echo '=== PROBE ==='; python3 - <<'PY'
import re,html,json,pathlib
w=pathlib.Path('/home/ai-core-node/frankenstein-avatar-go/c0dd67ea/evidence')
p=(w/'probe_dom-v2.html').read_text(errors='replace')
m=re.search(r'<output id="frank-perf-probe"[^>]*>(.*?)</output>',p,re.S)
assert m,'probe output missing'
s=html.unescape(m.group(1)); print(s); d=json.loads(s)
assert d['schema']=='FRANK_AVATAR_METRICS/v1'; assert d['count']>0; assert d['p95_ms'] is not None; assert 3800 <= d['breathing_period_ms'] <= 5600
print('PROBE_JSON_PASS')
n=(w/'normal_dom-v2.html').read_text(errors='replace')
assert not re.search(r'<output id="frank-perf-probe"',n),'probe output exists without probe=1'
print('NORMAL_NO_PROBE_PASS')
PY
echo '=== STATIC ==='; git -C "$C" diff --check; grep -q 'atmen(t);' "$C/buehne.html"; ! grep -q 'atemPhase += 0.006' "$C/buehne.html"; echo STATIC_PASS; echo '=== ERRORS ==='; tail -40 "$W/evidence/probe_chrome-v2.err" || true; rm -rf "$U" "$V"; echo G1_BROWSER_V2_PASS
